requirements_summary: Workloads: chat support-agent with KV cache, embeddings for document search, reranking for top-k retrievals.
Latency targets: p95 < 200ms for embeddings search; p95 < 150ms for short chat replies (<= 200 tokens).
Throughput: steady 120 QPS across embeddings service during peak business hours; burst to 400 QPS tolerated for 10min windows.
Availability/SLA: prefer 99.9% uptime for Dedicated; fallback route to hosted variants for regional outages.
Security: SSO/SAML for console, per-request audit logs exported to customer SIEM, KMS integration for key control, SOC2 attestation required.
Retention: configurable audit log retention windows per-route (30/90/365 days) plus long-term archival for EU subset (7 years).
Routing: multi-region routing with policy-based fallback (latency then cost).
